title: VMC Focus
summary: Demonstrates an accessible vulnerability-management triage cockpit with explainable risk prioritization and synthetic data.
purpose: Explore how security teams can turn multiple vulnerability signals into an understandable, traceable prioritization workflow.
responsibilities: Present a prioritized inbox of synthetic vulnerabilities and their risk signals.
Support search, filtering, sorting, responsive navigation, and accessible light and dark themes.
Demonstrate a portfolio-quality Angular application built with the SBB Lyne Design System.
boundaries: Is not an official SBB product.
Does not ingest production vulnerability, asset, identity, or remediation data.
Does not provide a production vulnerability scanner or remediation backend.
audience: Security and product practitioners evaluating vulnerability-triage interaction design.
Reviewers assessing frontend architecture, accessibility, and design-system integration.
useCases: Prioritize synthetic vulnerabilities by severity, exploitation probability, exposure, and remediation urgency.
Search and filter a triage inbox while retaining an independent sort order.
Inspect explainable risk signals in responsive light and dark layouts.

architecture.role: Standalone Angular portfolio application with local synthetic vulnerability data and SBB Lyne presentation components.
invariants: All demonstrated vulnerability information remains synthetic and non-confidential.
Risk priority remains explainable through visible contributing signals.
Information hierarchy and interactions remain accessible without relying on color alone.

limitations: The current implementation is a prototype and does not connect to live vulnerability-management systems.
